quality.serviceable_definition: v2: serviceable = RESOLVED THIS RUN ONLY (perPin resolved==true, plus any pincode that produced rows). known_serviceable-but-unresolved pins = coverage_carryover, EXCLUDED from all denominators.

notes: METHODOLOGY: brand availability % = pins with >=1 in-stock edible olive-oil SKU of that brand DIVIDED BY resolved-serviceable pins (resolved this run). Serviceable = perPin resolved==true in tonight's scrape, plus any pincode that produced product rows.

COVERAGE CARRYOVER: 0 pincodes are known-serviceable from earlier runs but did NOT resolve tonight; they are EXCLUDED from every denominator and disclosed here (meta.coverage_carryover) rather than silently deflating brand percentages.

Brand present at a pincode = >=1 EDIBLE olive-oil SKU in_stock there; non-edible (massage/hair/skin/cosmetic/baby) and blends excluded via taxonomy. Grades (pomace / extra_light / extra_virgin / pure_classic) are parsed deterministically from the product NAME.
NCR is a cross-cut over Delhi + Gurugram/Gurgaon/Faridabad + Noida/Greater Noida/Ghaziabad; it is NOT summed into the 9 states (no double count).
jivo_absent_rivals_present = serviceable pins where JIVO has no in-stock edible olive SKU but at least one competitor does (whitespace = actionable lead list).

jivo_lens compares yesterday's full-JIVO daily Blinkit scrape (ANY oil type) to tonight's olive study: JIVO the brand is often present via other oils where the olive shelf is the gap. null when the daily file was unavailable.
Deterministic: no LLM in the data path. Classification is exact-name map + brand/grade/exclude rules from taxonomy.json.
